During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of undercover [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agents once ran into an old '''rival''' n the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].

He was invited to a party organized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General]] [[Dandamont Pring]] at the [[Consul-General Pring's diplomatic estate|his estate]] on Bothawui. That very night, his Rebellion rivals were also present, disguised as trade delegates; [[Unidentified Imperial defector|bureaucrat]] was guiding them to an off-limits area. 

The Intelligence agents were forced to find a way to keep the rival from blowing their cover before ultimately succeeding in facilitating the bureaucrat's defection.
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The adventure offers the possible scenario that the rival inadvertently interferes with the agents' mission in such a way as to prevent Imperial forces from stopping the defection.
